title: Big Girls Don't Cry... They Get Even
description: Their mixed-up family follows when an unhappy teen (Hillary Wolf) and her stepbrother flee into the woods.

title: Rumor Has It ...
description: A woman (Jennifer Aniston) sets out to find the truth after learning that the movie "The Graduate" may have been based on her family.

title: Beyond the Poseidon Adventure
description: Salvagers (Michael Caine, Sally Field) seeking cash and a madman (Telly Savalas) seeking plutonium are trapped with survivors in an upside-down ocean liner.

title: After the Sunset
description: An FBI agent (Woody Harrelson) thinks a master thief (Pierce Brosnan) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) will try to steal a valuable diamond from a cruise ship.

title: Mr. Nice Guy
description: A gangster (Richard Norton) and his goons chase an ordinary guy (Jackie Chan) who helped a TV reporter (Gabrielle Fitzpatrick) escape their clutches.

title: Boiler Room
description: Eager to win the approval of his demanding father, a young man (Giovanni Ribisi) begins working for a dubious stock firm.

title: State and Main
description: A filmmaker (William H. Macy) copes with a predatory actor (Alec Baldwin), a demanding actress (Sarah Jessica Parker) and a major location problem as he tries to shoot a movie in small-town Vermont.

title: The Jacket
description: Cared for by a physician (Kris Kristofferson), an amnesiac Gulf War veteran (Adrien Brody) has violent flashbacks and visions of the future.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.

title: Ready to Rumble
description: Two die-hard fans vow to help wrestler Jimmy the King make a comeback after a loss destroys what was left of his career.

title: Ghosts of Mississippi
description: A Mississippi prosecutor (Alec Baldwin) and the widow (Whoopi Goldberg) of Medgar Evers crusade to retry a white racist (James Woods) for the 1963 murder of the NAACP leader.

title: The Hudsucker Proxy
description: A scheming executive promotes a mailroom worker to company president in the 1950s Manhattan.

title: Caddyshack II
description: The snobby president (Robert Stack) of a country club tees off with a self-made man (Jackie Mason) whose daughter wants to join.

title: Cannonball Run II
description: J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds), his mechanic (Dom DeLuise) and other veteran competitors enter another cross-country auto race.

title: Alex & Emma
description: A struggling writer (Luke Wilson) falls in love with a stenographer (Kate Hudson) while trying to finish his new novel in 30 days.

title: Sweet November
description: A workaholic executive (Keanu Reeves) and an unconventional woman (Charlize Theron) agree to a personal relationship for a trial period of one month.

title: Mars Attacks!
description: Martians take delight in incinerating humans in director Tim Burton's sendup of 1950s sci-fi classics.

title: Tenacious D in: The Pick of Destiny
description: Musicians JB (Jack Black) and KG (Kyle Gass) form rock group Tenacious D and set out on a quest for a legendary guitar pick that will make them the greatest band in the world.

title: Deep Cover
description: An undercover officer (Larry Fishburne) hooks up with a lawyer (Jeff Goldblum) who deals drugs for a West Coast cartel run by a foreign diplomat.

title: Collateral Damage
description: A Los Angeles firefighter (Arnold Schwarzenegger) travels to Colombia to find the terrorist who killed his wife and son.

title: The Golden Compass
description: In a parallel universe, young Lyra Belacqua journeys to the far North to save her best friend and other kidnapped children from terrible experiments by a mysterious organization.

title: Mr. Nanny
description: As a favor to his former trainer (Sherman Hemsley), a retired wrestler (Terry "Hulk" Hogan) takes a job as a computer tycoon's (Austin Pendleton) bodyguard.

title: Curly Sue
description: A con man (James Belushi) targets a corporate lawyer (Kelly Lynch) and steals her heart with his adorable adopted daughter (Alisan Porter).

title: Clara's Heart
description: A housekeeper (Whoopi Goldberg) befriends the teenage son of the bickering Baltimore couple (Michael Ontkean, Kathleen Quinlan) who brought her from Jamaica.

title: Preacher's Kid
description: A smooth-talking singer convinces a young woman (LeToya Luckett) to leave the security of her family, friends and church to join a traveling gospel show.

title: I Am Sam
description: A man (Sean Penn) with the mental capacity of a child hires a lawyer (Michelle Pfeiffer) to regain custody of his daughter.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: No Reservations
description: A career-centered chef (Catherine Zeta-Jones) faces important changes in her life when she becomes her young niece's guardian and crosses forks with a brash employee in her kitchen.

title: Before Sunrise
description: An American (Ethan Hawke) and a Frenchwoman (Julie Delpy) meet on a train and spend a romantic day and night in Vienna.

title: Addicted to Love
description: A man (Matthew Broderick) and a woman (Meg Ryan) meet by chance, then collaborate to spy on their exes, who are live-in lovers.

title: Dreamcatcher
description: While staying at a cabin in the woods, telepathic friends (Thomas Jane, Jason Lee) confront aliens that are being hunted by the military.

title: Forget Paris
description: Friends at a restaurant recall the romance of a yuppie couple (Billy Crystal, Debra Winger) who met in Paris four years before.

title: Overnight Delivery
description: A college student must prevent an impending disaster when he erroneously sends a poison-pen letter to his girlfriend.

title: Joe Versus the Volcano
description: A dying man (Tom Hanks) meets three women (Meg Ryan) on his way to Polynesia, where a tycoon (Lloyd Bridges) expects him to jump into a volcano.

title: Spies Like Us
description: Two clumsy bureaucrats (Chevy Chase, Dan Aykroyd) are trained as spies, then sent to Pakistan to create a diversion.

title: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Evil Mage Profion (Jeremy Irons) seeks Empress Savina's (Thora Birch) magic scepter in his quest to overtake the kingdom of Izmer for his group of magic users.

title: Revolution
description: A trapper (Al Pacino) joins the fight against the British in 1776 after his teenage son is tortured by a redcoat (Donald Sutherland).

title: Nothing but Trouble
description: Four trendy New Yorkers face a crazed judge and other horrors in the village of Valkenvania.

title: Men Don't Leave
description: An indebted widow (Jessica Lange) sells the family home and starts over with her two sons (Chris O'Donnell, Charlie Korsmo) in Baltimore.

title: Fathers' Day
description: Two Californians (Robin Williams, Billy Crystal) seek a former girlfriend's missing son, each believing he is the father of the boy.

title: Private Benjamin
description: A pampered Jewish widow (Goldie Hawn) is tricked into joining the Army and unexpectedly finds a new sense of purpose and self-worth.

title: Vision Quest
description: A teenage wrestler (Matthew Modine) has trouble focusing on his training regimen when a worldly drifter (Linda Fiorentino) takes up temporary residence at his home.
